name: Payment Dependency Diff
purpose: Record every dependency-edge change introduced by the Payment boundary extraction. Allowed edges are enumerated so that future phases can detect re-introduction of forbidden dependencies.

summary.net_dependency_direction: Controllers -> Application -> Domain <- Infrastructure (strictly inward for business rules; persistence and vendor SDK strictly outward)

App\\Domain: nothing — no framework, no persistence, no vendor SDK

edges_added.rationale: Pending-payment reuse lookup moved out of the use case's inline Eloquent call.
Gateway-order lookup and payment creation moved behind a persistence contract.
Replaces three inline paise conversions with one audited helper.
REMOVES the Razorpay\Api\Api dependency. This is the only architecture violation eliminated in this phase.
Replaces the inline refund amount conversion and full-refund ternary.
Controller no longer reaches the service directly.
Status read-model construction moved out of HTTP.
Live refund path now enters through the application boundary.
Replaces the inline app(ReferralTrackingService::class) service-locator call.
Offline payment recording enters through the application boundary.
Deliberate, documented exception: this is a read-model builder, not a business-rule owner. The alternative (a query-side repository) was judged over-engineering for a single 8-column projection.

edges_removed.note: The read-side settlement/refund listing methods still depend on RefundService; those are pure reads and are explicitly out of scope.

service_locators_removed.rationale: Unresolvable-at-static-analysis service locator; now constructor-injected and testable.

unresolved_violations.rationale: Referral attribution and partner commission creation are a genuine part of the payment-success transition, not an accidental coupling. Removing it would change transaction semantics. Documented in ADR-P09-03, not 'fixed'.

verification.vendor_sdk_leak_scan: Only Razorpay\Api\Api import in app/ is app/Infrastructure/Payments/Razorpay/RazorpayPaymentGateway.php
verification.http_layer_client_scan: No GuzzleHttp / Http:: / curl_init references under app/Http
